title: Berserkir mead

infobox.Other Effect(s): Attack, Block and Dodge Stamina use -80%, Weak (x1.5) against Slash, Blunt and Pierce damage

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Berserkir mead is a Plains-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Berserkir.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Mead base: Berserkir is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Mushroom
• 10 Yellow mushroom
• 1 Toadstool
Three Berserkir meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: Consuming it grants a reduction to attack, block and dodge stamina use by -80% for 20s, but it makes the player weak (x1.5) against Slash, Blunt and Pierce damage.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text:
• Because of how resistance stacking works - in that being Resistant overrides being Weak - the Bonemass power will prevent the negatives of this potion and instead leave the player with resistance to Slash, Blunt and Pierce while preserving the benefits of the potion.
• There is no cooldown on Berserkir mead, so you can quaff one every 20 seconds, giving you the chance to use 15 Berserkir meads during one Bonemass duration.

full_text:
Berserkir mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadBzerker | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Berserkir x1 | Duration: 20s | Cooldown: 2m | Other Effect(s): Attack, Block and Dodge Stamina use -80%, Weak (x1.5) against Slash, Blunt and Pierce damage

Introduction. Berserkir mead is a Plains-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Berserkir.

Recipe. Mead base: Berserkir is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Mushroom
• 10 Yellow mushroom
• 1 Toadstool
Three Berserkir meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

Effect. Consuming it grants a reduction to attack, block and dodge stamina use by -80% for 20s, but it makes the player weak (x1.5) against Slash, Blunt and Pierce damage.

Tips. • Because of how resistance stacking works - in that being Resistant overrides being Weak - the Bonemass power will prevent the negatives of this potion and instead leave the player with resistance to Slash, Blunt and Pierce while preserving the benefits of the potion.
• There is no cooldown on Berserkir mead, so you can quaff one every 20 seconds, giving you the chance to use 15 Berserkir meads during one Bonemass duration.
